svg.title: Which way to connect Paperless-ngx and Nextcloud fits
svg.desc: When only files should go into Paperless, Nextcloud's Paperless integration sends single files by hand, the inbox of Paperless Sync takes every file put into a folder of Nextcloud, with the export turned off if you like, and Paperless's own consume folder, mail fetcher and apps take scans from a phone, a mail or a scanner. When the documents of Paperless should appear in Nextcloud Files, the question is whether you can install apps in your Nextcloud. If not, such as with a hosted Nextcloud, the WebDAV container or an rclone script copy them over WebDAV. If you can, and a read-only view of Paperless's own files is enough, an external-storage mount fits, of a local folder or over SMB or SFTP; for a tidy archive by correspondent, type and year, an inbox to Paperless and deletions only after confirmation, Paperless Sync. The questions are orange, the options green.
